name: Hag’s Hex
body:
Your natural connection with witches grants you access to a single hex.

Prerequisite(s): Hag, caster level 1st.

Benefit(s): Choose one of the following hexes: cauldron, disguise, misfortune, poison steep, scar, swamp hag, tongues, or unnerve beasts. You gain that hex, using your Charisma modifier in place of your Intelligence modifier and your caster level in place of your witch level.

Special: You may take this feat multiple times, but must choose a different hex each time.
